title: docs: BYOP models param grants categories, not specific models
author: lotxo1

gist.summary: Corrected BYOP documentation: the `models` authorize parameter grants access to model categories, not individual models. Supplying a model ID grants its entire category, including models added later; `budget` is the option for spending caps. The restricted-key example now uses `models=image,text`. The README and SDK `AuthorizeOptions.models` comment use the same category-based wording. No key behavior changed.

Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, never oversized, and strictly pixel art. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent soft lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
